materialChangesThisRun.area: Minecraft Recommendations Vault reproducible source package
materialChangesThisRun.detail: The complete reproducible source package exists on connected Google Drive as Minecraft Recommendations Vault - Explorer Source.zip, Drive file 1vRty6Q7cE7ImM3PUDe4fqXmh2zGXOHLD, exactly 596,027 bytes with SHA-256 447a64380fc71e50076b03da52f4c7a5357eaae50943bc28cc597d5f86c97461 and valid ZIP integrity. The expected GitHub root artifact is still missing. Existing large base64 staging is not a viable publication path because connected GitHub file-content writes clamp large payloads, leaving incomplete staging. A safer small-chunk staging path was partially exercised but is not itself publication. A direct GitHub Actions Drive-to-GitHub recovery workflow was added and triggered with exact byte/hash/ZIP verification and remote round-trip verification, but the public runner could not retrieve the private Drive object, so no root ZIP was published. The connected Drive tool exposes no sharing/permission action and the connected GitHub tool exposes no direct binary upload from the mounted Drive file. The publication debt remains open; no incomplete or failed artifact has been promoted.

health.userEscalationAction: Make Google Drive file 1vRty6Q7cE7ImM3PUDe4fqXmh2zGXOHLD (Minecraft Recommendations Vault - Explorer Source.zip) accessible to Anyone with the link as Viewer so the existing GitHub recovery workflow can download, verify, publish, and round-trip verify the exact artifact.
